description_en: Adds a binding relationship for an AXN private number. An AXN private number assigns an exclusive private number to User A, and any number N can reach User A by dialing number X
description_zh: 添加AXN隐私号的绑定关系。AXN隐私号是为A用户分配一个专属的隐私号，任何号码N通过拨打X号码都可以转接到A
name: BindAxn

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page in the privacy protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
Number A of the AXN private number.
Number A can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. If Number A is a landline number, you must add the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的A号码。
A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: phone_noa

parameters.help_en:
Number B of the AXN private number.

Number B can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. If Number B is a landline number, you must add the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number.
When Number A dials Number X, the call is forwarded to Number B by default. If Number B is not set, the call cannot be connected.
When Number A dials Number X, the call is forwarded to Number B only when the Number A callback mode is set to Default mode. Otherwise, the call cannot be connected.
To modify the Number A callback mode, go to Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1) > filter by AXN private number > Number Pool Management > Number A callback mode > Adjust Configuration.
To update Number B, call the UpdateSubscription (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription) operation
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
A号码拨打X号码时，默认会转接到B号码，如B号码未设置，则无法接通。
A号码拨打X号码时，A号码回拨模式为默认模式时，才会转接到B号码，若不是默认模式，则无法接通。
如需修改A号码回拨模式，在号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1)>筛选AXN隐私号>号池管理>A号码回拨模式>调整配置修改。
如需更新B号码，请调用UpdateSubscription (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i11)接口更新
parameters.name: phone_nob

parameters.help_en:
Number X of the AXN private number.

Number X is the private number that you have purchased (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) in the console.

If Number X is not specified, a number is randomly selected from the specified number pool based on the ExpectCity parameter as Number X
parameters.help_zh:
AXN隐私号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)。

如果未指定X号码时，将根据参数ExpectCity从指定号码池中随机指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: phone_nox

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the binding relationship. Unit: seconds.

The expiration time must be at least 60 seconds later than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系的过期时间，单位：秒。

必须晚于当前时间60秒以上
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en:
The city where Number X is selected.

If no available numbers exist in the specified city in the current number pool, or if this parameter is not specified, a number from another city is randomly assigned from the current number pool as Number X.
If the Number X allocation mode is set to Strict match mode, the system returns an allocation error when no eligible numbers are available
parameters.help_zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

如果当前号码池中没有该城市的可用号码，或未指定此参数，将从当前号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
如果X号码分配模式配置为严格匹配模式，当符合条件的号码不存在时，系统会提示分配错误
parameters.name: expect_city

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record all calls generated for this binding relationship. Valid values:

true: Records calls.
false: Does not record calls. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要针对该绑定关系产生的所有通话录制通话录音。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音（默认值）
parameters.name: is_recording_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The number type.

This parameter applies only to legacy Alibaba Dayu customers. Alibaba Cloud users can ignore this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
号码类型。

适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略
parameters.name: no_type

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The number display logic in the binding relationship. Set the value to 1, which indicates that the intermediate Number X is displayed for both the caller and the callee.

Due to carrier regulations, the setting to display the real number during a call does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值：1（主被叫显示中间号码X）。

由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效
parameters.name: call_display_type

parameters.help_en:
Settings for the corporate ringback tone played when Number X receives a dial-up after the AXN privacy number is attached.

Specify the ringtone field and the ringback tone encoding for this parameter.

Ringtone field valid values:
AXNRing_AB: The ringtone Settings before Number A makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected (with a callback number) in an AXN attachment.
AXNRing_A: The ringtone Settings before Number A makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected (without a callback number) in an AXN attachment.
AXNRing_N: The ringtone Settings before Number N makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected in an AXN attachment.
AXNRing_A_PICKUP: The ringtone Settings after Number A makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected in an AXN attachment.
AXNRing_N_PICKUP: The ringtone Settings after Number N makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected in an AXN attachment.

Ringback tone encoding:

You can obtain the corporate ringback tone encoding on the Corporate Ringback Tone Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page in the privacy protection console.

Example:

To set the ringtone Settings before Number A makes a dial-up to Number X and the call is connected (without a callback number), enter "AXNRing_A": "1000****1".

The corporate ringback tone configured at the attachment level takes precedence. If no ringback tone is configured at the attachment level or the configuration does not take effect, the ringback tone configured at the number pool level is used
parameters.help_zh:
设置AXN隐私号在号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃。

此参数请填写铃音字段和彩铃编码。

铃音字段取值：
AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（有回拨号码）：AXNRing_AB
AXN中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（无回拨号码）：AXNRing_A
AXN中，N侧号码打X接通前的铃音设置：AXNRing_N
AXN中，A号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_A_PICKUP
AXN中，N号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_N_PICKUP

彩铃编码：

在号码隐私保护控制台企业彩铃管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

填写示例：

如设置A号码拨打X接通前的铃音（无回拨号码），填写："AXNRing_A": "1000****1"。

企业彩铃优先使用绑定级别设置的彩铃，如果未设置或设置未生效，则会使用号码池级别的彩铃音
parameters.name: ring_config

parameters.help_en:
The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) status. Valid values:

false: Disabled. This is the default value.
true: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
ASR状态。取值：

false：关闭（默认值）
true：开启
parameters.name: asr_status

parameters.help_en:
The ASR model ID. Valid values:

7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac: General-Telephone-Mandarin Chinese model ID.

9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77: General-Telephone-Cantonese model ID.

3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b: General-Telephone-Regional accent model ID
parameters.help_zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

通用-电话-中文普通话模型 ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

通用-电话-中文粤语模型 ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

通用-电话-地方口音模型 ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en:
The call restriction status for a single call. Valid values:

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Number A cannot dial Number X.
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Number B cannot dial Number X
parameters.help_zh:
单通呼叫限制的状态。取值：

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫X号码
parameters.name: call_restrict
